decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing house.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted numbered D/01 Received 12/08/2010 and Amended plans D/01A Received 24/09/2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side and rear walls of the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The detached outbuilding shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as 223 Brabazon Road, Hounslow and for no other purpose.
description: Erection of an outbuilding to be used as a games room and storage area.
